status: Registered design; freeze actual purchase source hash after qualified upstream run completes, before any purchase calls
upstream_prerequisites: All96 supplied execution/factual checks and known32 factual-stress checks; manual sequence review. Output coverage is structural, not independently learned human behavior.
financial_prerequisites: Citizen-facing v6 prompt and v4 financial contract pass18 scarcity/fact cases and96 fixed-upstream financial development cases, without altering raw choices.
people: Original12 known development citizens; same calendar on/off across four known mechanisms. No P015.
quote_provider: Existing hypothetical BOOK, fixed before current candidate outputs; identical per-item price in every arm and district. Do not tune prices against effects.
primary_measure: Mean paired on-off difference in candidate-catalog purchase spending, including valid zero and online purchases, for each mechanism. Relative difference uses off mean; zero denominator is undefined.
secondary_measures: asset acquisition cash outflow separately from consumption
unblinding_rule: Freeze candidate/protocol and source before purchase calls; report every mechanism regardless of direction. Never choose a prompt, price or eligibility rule because its effect matches a target.
completeness: Audit exact planner-source hashes, decision IDs, identical executed activities, and full citizen x same-date x seed x on/off matrix. Failed or missing paths are not zero-filled or omitted; their mechanism is not scored.
external_comparison: No historical effect-size accuracy score here: one-day individual hypothetical catalogs do not match household monthly/DDD or epidemic-total external estimates. Preserve this incompatibility explicitly.
interpretation: A pipeline and conditional effect measurement pilot, not the final policy validity verdict. One joint path replicate gives no confidence interval or significance claim. Does not redefine the full research objective.
